description: This file contains custom autograd Function classes for distributed tensor operations such as broadcast, gather, scatter, and reduce, used in PyTorch's parallel processing framework.

classes.name: Broadcast
classes.description: Implements distributed broadcast operation for tensors across GPUs.

classes.name: ReduceAddCoalesced
classes.description: Implements reduction and addition of tensors across GPUs.

classes.name: Gather
classes.description: Gathers tensors from multiple GPUs to a single device.

classes.name: Scatter
classes.description: Distributes a tensor across multiple GPUs.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the respective distributed operation.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes the gradient for the respective operation during backpropagation.
